failure_patterns.pattern: no_key_domain_not_first_searched: Hotel details (dates, stars, neighborhood, check-out, 'Yes' to a hotel offer) arrived while CACHE had no hotels key. The agent re-filtered flights, loaded a nonexistent 'hotels' key (None crash), or re-saved the restaurants entry unchanged instead of calling search_hotels.

rejected_edits.content: . Earlier turns are already inside the cached entry; never re-pass them.
rejected_edits.target: , plus any earlier-stated constraint that the CACHE summary text ("Additionally filtering for ..." / search description) does not show as applied.
Include an earlier-stated constraint only if the summary does NOT list it.
